purpose: Resume-safe production ledger for bilingual, chapter-specific Class 6 Science lesson data. This tracks content authoring only; it does not imply application implementation, source completeness, approval or publication.
non_negotiable_rules: Every authored lesson belongs to exactly one canonical chapter and one topic within that chapter.
No lesson explanation, visual, interaction, example, or practice item may teach concepts from another chapter. Incidental chapter-scope examples must not become mini-lessons on later topics.

English and Hindi are authored as a paired record from the same canonical learning objectives. Preserve identical learning-objective IDs, block IDs, asset IDs, question IDs, answer IDs, scoring logic and expected difficulty.
Every lesson contains a distinct explain section and practice section.
Practice must contain multiple question types. Each item has localized prompt/options/feedback and a bilingual answer key or rubric, with consistent grading between languages.
Generated explanations, diagrams and practice questions must be labelled as authored material, not represented as verbatim NCERT content.

Only source-derived material is grounded by the book. Original teaching diagrams must be clearly marked as generated. V3 visual candidates remain review-only until each is checked for semantic fit, alt text, provenance, rights and approval.
A lesson marked generated is not thereby source-complete, fact-checked, bilingual-approved or publishable.
After every newly generated topic lesson, commit the lesson JSON first, then immediately update this progress index with commit/path, status and exact next step.
Work on these content artifacts only unless UI implementation is separately requested. Preserve existing application data and workflows.

resume_instructions: Read this index first and open the exact lesson artifact recorded above.
Do not regenerate or overwrite completed lesson JSON blindly; inspect it and make additive corrections.
Continue on main; do not create an extra branch for this content-authoring stream.
For the active topic, resolve Hindi page mapping and source visual review gaps and update its status only when evidence exists.
Then generate topic 2 with a separate explain/practice structure and paired en/hi content. Commit it, then update this index immediately.
Do not mark a chapter complete until every topic has source reconciliation, visual mapping, bilingual parity and practice review.
